reading.body:
A building named Strategic Datasphere exists at this address in Alpharetta, Georgia, according to OpenStreetMap. No operator has been identified, no power capacity has been published, and no specifications beyond location are on file. This registry's search tool is exhausted and cannot resolve the operator without guessing from the name alone, which policy prohibits.

Georgia has 33 mapped data center facilities, of which only 4 have published power capacity. Those four facilities together account for 66.3 megawatts of declared IT load. This facility ranks fifth by published capacity in the state, which means it either publishes no capacity figure or sits below the threshold of the four published sites.

Without published power, capacity utilization, power delivery infrastructure, or grid connection details, this campus cannot be read as a constraint or asset in AI scaling. The facts on record do not establish whether it is active, what it hosts, or whether it matters to the question of compute availability.
